title: Squadron Leader Bhawana Kanth Becomes First Woman IAF 'Top Gun' Combat Leader
summary: 1st woman to graduate from IAF Fighter Combat Leader course after 20-week training.

blocks.content: 1st woman to graduate from IAF Fighter Combat Leader course after 20-week training.

items: Squadron Leader Bhawana Kanth became the first woman fighter pilot in IAF history to qualify as a 'Top Gun' Combat Leader.
Completed Tactics and Air Combat Development Establishment (TACDE) course.
